deferred_subsumption.why_not_discharged: Discharging it would mean showing that the canonical proposition ENTAILS the source one — that every model of `the receipt binds the transitive evidence closure of everything a transition promotes` is a model of `the receipt binds the import closure of the gates`. Both propositions are prose about a mechanism, not formulae, so the entailment is read by a person and the reading is what would have to be discharged. Nothing in this tree can do that yet, and the honest consequence is that this disposition is DECLARED and FAC-INTEGRATION-SUBSUMPTION is OPEN, not that the disposition is wrong.
